SELECT p.playlist_idx AS playlistIdx, p.member_id AS memberId, p.playlist_name AS playlistName, p.open_yn AS openYn, COUNT(pd.detail_idx) AS musicCount
FROM playlist p
LEFT JOIN playlist_detail pd ON p.playlist_idx = pd.playlist_idx
WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId}
GROUP BY p.playlist_idx, p.member_id, p.playlist_name, p.open_yn
ORDER BY p.playlist_idx DESC

SELECT pd.detail_idx AS detailIdx, pd.playlist_idx AS playlistIdx, pd.recommendation_idx AS recommendationIdx,
p.playlist_name AS playlistName, p.description AS description, mb.member_name AS memberName,
b.book_title AS bookTitle, b.book_author AS bookAuthor,
m.music_title AS musicTitle, m.music_artist AS musicArtist, m.music_url AS musicUrl
FROM playlist_detail pd
INNER JOIN playlist p ON pd.playlist_idx = p.playlist_idx
INNER JOIN member mb ON p.member_id = mb.member_id
INNER JOIN recommendation r ON pd.recommendation_idx = r.recommendation_idx
INNER JOIN book b ON r.book_idx = b.book_idx
INNER JOIN music m ON r.music_idx = m.music_idx
WHERE pd.playlist_idx = #{playlistIdx}
ORDER BY pd.detail_idx DESC

SELECT p.playlist_idx AS playlistIdx, p.member_id AS memberId, p.playlist_name AS playlistName, p.open_yn AS openYn, p.description AS description,
m.member_name AS memberName, md.mbti AS mbti,
COUNT(pd.detail_idx) AS musicCount
FROM playlist p
INNER JOIN member m ON p.member_id = m.member_id
LEFT JOIN member_detail md ON p.member_id = md.member_id
LEFT JOIN playlist_detail pd ON p.playlist_idx = pd.playlist_idx
WHERE p.open_yn = 1
GROUP BY p.playlist_idx, p.member_id, p.playlist_name, p.open_yn, p.description, m.member_name, md.mbti
ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.member_id = #{memberId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.playlist_idx DESC
